job-interview-example.label: Example Co — Head of Growth interview
job-interview-example.fitSummary: Position yourself as an operator who has grown a funnel from zero, not just studied one.
proofBank: 4x signups in one year at Acme Analytics
Shipped hardware+software to 200 stores at Bright Robotics
job-interview-example.honestGap: No formal experience running paid acquisition at seven-figure budgets. Bridge: strong organic/product-led growth results and a fast learning method.
questionsToAsk: What does success look like in the first 90 days?
How does growth work with product and sales today?
settledAnswers: Compensation: base range $140-160K, open to full package.
neverSay: Don't claim you ran the paid acquisition budget yourself; you advised on it.

fixedLine.primary: I'm looking at a base in the $140 to 160K range, and I'm flexible on the full package.

watchOuts.tip: Give a range only when asked directly.

sales-call-notes-example.label: Example Co — discovery call notes
sales-call-notes-example.goal: Qualify the deal and book a technical demo
sales-call-notes-example.fitSummary: Same-language notes mode: no translation, just a live transcript plus tactical prompts toward booking the demo.
proofBank: Case study: cut onboarding time 60% for a similar-sized customer
sales-call-notes-example.honestGap: Pricing is above their stated budget. Bridge: offer the pilot tier and revisit at renewal.
questionsToAsk: Who else needs to sign off on a purchase like this?
settledAnswers: Pricing floor: no discount below the pilot tier without approval.
neverSay: Don't promise a delivery date before checking with delivery.

fixedLine.primary: I can put together pilot pricing and get you an exact number by tomorrow.

watchOuts.tip: Never quote a discount live; always follow up in writing.

client-call-translation-example.label: Example Co — Spanish-speaking client check-in
client-call-translation-example.goal: Reassure the client and secure a renewal commitment
client-call-translation-example.fitSummary: Translation mode: any two languages work, not just the pair in this example.
proofBank: Delivered 99.9% uptime over the last renewal period
client-call-translation-example.honestGap: No account history before this quarter. Bridge: the team's uptime record and a named point of contact.
questionsToAsk: ¿Qué necesitarían ver para renovar con confianza?
neverSay: Don't promise a discount without finance sign-off.

fixedLine.primary: Puedo confirmar el precio exacto con el equipo y responderle mañana.
fixedLine.other: I can confirm the exact price with the team and get back to you tomorrow.

watchOuts.tip: Never confirm pricing live; always follow up in writing.

avoid: Do not claim a skill or result you don't actually have.
Do not ramble through your full history — pick one proof point.
